capabilities: Run TABLE, LIST and TASK query blocks over frontmatter, inline fields, tags and file metadata
Evaluate inline expressions and inline JavaScript in Reading view and Live Preview
Script queries and custom rendering through a JavaScript API (cfr/dv)
Toggle tasks and record completion dates from query results
Query CSV files as sources and expose the index to other plugins via window.CfrJsAPI
extras: Warns that cfrjs blocks and $= inline expressions run JavaScript with Obsidian's own permissions and can be disabled in settings; mobile is marked compatible but not extensively tested; development/benchmark instructions included.
intentEvidence: Its query language, API names and field names follow Dataview's conventions so existing queries keep working.
problem: Vault-wide queries over note metadata get slow on large vaults, and query rendering and indexing do not adapt to what is actually visible or changed.

relations.evidence: Dataview-compatible syntax, written from scratch with a focus on performance on large vaults.

summary: Dataview-compatible vault query engine that renders TABLE, LIST and TASK blocks, inline expressions and a JavaScript API, focused on large-vault performance.
